::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** April 18th [1896]  
**From:** G F S Elderfield Otterbourne Winchester  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Miss Compton](people/person_364.qmd)
Would you be so kind as to answer this lady, as you understand the [Reading Union](organizations/other_211.qmd) much better than I do

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

**Note:** Agnes Charlotte Compton (b. 1863), daughter of the Rev. John Compton, Rector of Minstead with Lyndhurst. Envelope postmarked Winchester 2.45.PM Ap 18 96 and addressed ‘Miss A C Compton/Rectory/ Minstead/Lyndhurst’ and forwarded to ‘c/o Canon Lucas/Shortlands/Kent’.
